query:
update document set montant_ht = $2::float8::numeric(14, 2),
                   montant_tva = $3::float8::numeric(14, 2), montant_ttc = $4::float8::numeric(14, 2),
                   confiance = coalesce(confiance, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('montants_calcules', $5::jsonb)
               where id = $1
